page.overview:
What is Meowstic?

Meowstic is a two-tailed bipedal feline Pokémon. It is likely based on the nekomata, a mystical twin-tailed cat creature of Japanese folklore. Meowstic's fur is deep blue and white in color. When folded, its sharp, conical ears resemble cat ears, but when unfurled, Meowstic's ears are very long, similar in appearance to rabbit ears. Meowstic's folded ears are similar to those of a Scottish Fold cat. Beneath its folded ears, Meowstic hides luminous eye-shaped glands from which it releases extremely powerful psychokinetic attacks. When unfolding its ears and releasing its contained psychic powers, Meowstic's eyes glow brightly and its pupils seem to disappear.

Male and female Meowstic seem to be completely inverse of each other; the male Meowstic is mainly deep blue-colored with some white patches, while the female Meowstic is mainly white-colored with some deep blue patches. Their eyes are also different; a male Meowstic has a light green sclera and dark green irises, whereas female Meowstic have yellow scelera and red irises. Meowstic's tails also differ in appearance depending on its gender: the male form has long, upright, fluffy tails, while the female form has shorter curled tails.

Shiny Meowstic swap all of their blue fur for yellow regardless of gender; the eye color remains the same.

Male and female Meowstic are inverses of each other-whereas the males have short, spiky dark blue fur with white accents, females have long, curled white fur with dark blue accents. Eye color is also dependent on gender-males have green eyes, females yellow. The Pokémon itself is among the most notable physical differences between gender.
